description: 한국도로교통공단_세부링크 도로위험지수 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국도로교통공단. - 실시간 도로위험도지수정보를 제공하는 세부링크별 도로위험도지수정보 조회 서비스 표준노드링크를 세부 단위로 쪼개어(교차로: 30m, 일반도로100m) 경로와 차종코드를 이용하여. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국도로교통공단. Its tags are 세부링크, 도로위험도지수, 교통사고, 도로위험등급, 실시간. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-03-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
